"""Freeze the changed-data schedule and original source bindings before inspection."""
import shutil
from pathlib import Path
import numpy as np
from fine_mesh_training_data import edit_recipe, selected_mesh_batch
from train_directional_bank_trial import read,ref,save
repo=Path('/home/dllu/proj/demosaic');root=repo/'.cache/quality-20261107/V168-fine-mesh-ladder-v1';external=Path('/mnt/external/demosaic/quality-20261107/V168-fine-mesh-ladder-v1')
assert not root.exists() and not external.exists()
previous=repo/'.cache/quality-20261107/V167-bounded-support-v1';prior=read(previous/'plan-v1.json');cache=read(prior['cache']['path'])
selected=[];ordinal=0
for item in cache['batches']:
 if item['metadata']['domain']!='mesh':continue
 if selected_mesh_batch(ordinal):
  selected.append({'step':item['step'],'mesh_ordinal':ordinal,'old_arrays':item['arrays'],'old_parent':item['parent'],
   'recipes':[edit_recipe(item['metadata']['cases'][2*p]['source']['present_recipe'],ordinal,p) for p in range(2)]})
 ordinal+=1
assert ordinal==341 and len(selected)==171
chosen=[r['step'] for r in selected[:4]]
for criterion in [lambda c:c['metadata']['noise']['shot']==c['metadata']['noise']['read']==0,lambda c:c['metadata']['noise']['shot']==.00256]:
 chosen.append(next(r['step'] for r in selected if r['step'] not in chosen and criterion(cache['batches'][r['step']-1])))
expected=sum(Path(r['old_arrays']['path']).stat().st_size+Path(r['old_parent']['path']).stat().st_size for r in selected)
quality=2*prior['expected_new_quality_bytes_per_endpoint']
assert shutil.disk_usage(repo).free>56.75*2**30
assert shutil.disk_usage('/mnt/external').free>116.5*2**30+expected+quality
root.mkdir(parents=True);external.mkdir();work=root/'data-work'
files=list((repo/'src/demosaic').glob('*.py'))+[repo/'scripts'/n for n in ['fine_mesh_training_data.py','paired_response_data.py','paired_response_objective.py','coupled_sensor_noise.py','paired_response_counters.py','train_directional_bank_trial.py','train_v43_quality_trial.py','profile_raw_kernel_inference.py']]
files+=[repo/'tests/test_fine_mesh_training_data.py',repo/'tests/test_paired_response_data.py']
for source in files:
 dest=work/source.relative_to(repo);dest.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True);shutil.copyfile(source,dest)
plan={'root':str(root),'external_root':str(external),'work':str(work),'previous':str(previous),'cache':prior['cache'],'parent':prior['parent'],
 'expected_DINO_sha256':'691963f0f796aac860d818d59d9d14287a4675612829fbe9467c7f5df8ce5b14',
 'selected':selected,'inspection_steps':chosen,'selected_mesh_batches':171,'selected_mesh_pairs':342,'unchanged_batches':829,
 'contrast_band_pair_counts':[86,86,85,85],'nominal_period_pixels':[6,10],'contrast_band_edges':[.02,.05,.125,.25,.4],
 'expected_new_cache_bytes':expected,'expected_later_new_quality_bytes':quality,'reserves_GiB':{'local':56,'external':116,'projection_margin':.5,'local_remaining_bound':.25},
 'launch_RAM_GiB':52,'runtime_RAM_GiB':32,'CUDA_quota_GiB':12,'parent_precision':'FP32,TF32 disabled,existing frozen parent unchanged',
 'inputs':[prior['cache'],ref(previous/'plan-v1.json'),ref(repo/'docs/results/mesh-training-coverage-20261107-v1.json'),ref(prior['parent']['path'])],
 'frozen_files':{str(p):ref(p)['sha256'] for p in work.rglob('*') if p.is_file()},
 'all90_neural_hashes':{str(p):ref(p)['sha256'] for p in (repo/'src/demosaic').glob('*.py')},
 'preparer':dict(ref(Path(__file__)),text=Path(__file__).read_text()),
 'scope':'Data preparation for a fixed V168 distribution comparison.171/341 mesh batches change both nominal wire periods6..32->6..10 and balanced contrast bands.02..05..125..25..4;170 mesh and659 nonmesh batches keep original arrays and parent predictions. All geometry,slopes,level,tint,width,angles,phases,mask,camera,CFA,noise coefficients and sensor seed remain fixed;empty clean targets exactly match. Poisson rates change so same seeds do not mean identical noisy empty frames. All342 new pairs retain exact empty counterfactuals. This jointly tests frequency/contrast distribution,not either factor separately. Both later heads use identical V167 bounded architecture/loss/init/optimizer;control must reproduce V167. Only procedural recipes supply new training pixels;no photos,held-out references,RAW/original/dataz access. Six selected input batches will be inspected and adopted once;171 total new frozen parent/DINO roots planned. Existing evidence and all90 neural sources remain unchanged;no quality claim.'}
save(root/'data-plan-v1.json',plan)
save(repo/'docs/results/v168-fine-mesh-data-plan-v1.json',plan)
print('Prepared',len(selected),'new batches;inspection',chosen,'cache GiB',expected/2**30,'quality GiB',quality/2**30)
